Latin Small Letter E With Diaeresis Alt Code and Symbol

The Alt code for Latin Small Letter E With Diaeresis is 137. Hold Alt, type 137 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt. Latin Small Letter E With Diaeresis also has the Unicode codepoint U+00EB, so you can type it with Alt+235 on Windows, search for U+00EB in macOS's Character Viewer, use ë in HTML, or \00EB in CSS. If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly — the Alt key method requires a physical numpad. Copy the Latin Small Letter E With Diaeresis character from this page when you need it in a form, chat message or document that does not accept Alt codes. HTML also defines the named entity ë for Latin Small Letter E With Diaeresis, but the numeric form ë is safer when compatibility is uncertain.

How to type latin small letter e with diaeresis on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 1 3 7 on the numeric keypad.
  4. Release Alt. The Latin Small Letter E With Diaeresis character (ë) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type latin small letter e with diaeresis on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Latin Small Letter E With Diaeresis. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Latin Small Letter E With Diaeresis" and click the character to insert it.

How to use latin small letter e with diaeresis in code

  • HTML: or , also
  • CSS: content:"\00EB"; ()
  • Python: \u00EB or chr(0xEB)
  • JavaScript: \u00EB or String.fromCodePoint(0xEB)
  • JSON: "\u00EB"

Frequently asked questions

What is the Alt code for Latin Small Letter E With Diaeresis?

The legacy Alt code for Latin Small Letter E With Diaeresis is 137. Hold Alt, type 1 3 7 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt.

How do I type ë without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ë, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+235 not work?

Alt+235 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Latin Small Letter E With Diaeresis?

The Unicode codepoint for Latin Small Letter E With Diaeresis is U+00EB. You can use this value in HTML as ë, in CSS as \00EB, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ë on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+00EB, then click it.
